recipe.description: must match the folder's target.yaml recipe

must_find.description: each entry must full-match at least one finding on every listed where key

must_hypothesize.description: each entry must full-match at least one hypothesis (id, title, rationale, next_step); counted in recall

must_not_find.description: decoys: any finding full-matching one fails precision

artifacts.description: files the run must write under evidence/; scored on real runs, counted in recall

recipe_eval_checks.description: recipe eval check types scored on top of the generic ones (tool_ran, artifact_exists, artifact_absent, no_demotions, evidence schema); 'all' scores every check

where.description: finding field name -> full-match regex (rule, location, cwe, target, title, severity, tool)

path.description: glob relative to the run's workspace/evidence/ dir

contains.description: regex searched in the file text; omitted means the file exists and is not empty
